game.testScenariosDesc: Select a position to test the Last Stand mechanism:
game.scenarioRetaliationDesc: White captures BK with WP1 -> Black BP1 automatically retaliates -> Ends in Draw.
game.scenarioImmediateWinDesc: White captures BK with WP1 -> Black cannot retaliate against WK -> White wins immediately.
game.rulesBoardDesc: Cross-shaped 20-tile board. Each tile has a value of 1, 2, or 3.
game.rulesPiecesDesc: Each team has 1 King + 2 Pawns. Pawns cannot be captured.
game.rulesMovementDesc: Step count required each turn = value of the tile opponent's King stands on. You must move exactly that many steps.
game.rulesCaptureDesc: Only Kings can be captured — Pawns are invincible. You cannot land on your own pieces or opponent Pawns.
game.rulesWinDesc: Safely capture the opponent's King -> Win! Opponent has no legal moves -> Win!
game.rulesLastStandDesc: When a King is captured, opponent gets ONE LAST TURN. If they capture your King -> Draw! Otherwise -> They lose!
game.rulesDrawDesc: Both Kings captured back-to-back -> Draw. Position repeated 3 times -> Draw (Threefold Repetition).
game.rulesReversalDesc: You cannot reverse your previous move unless no other legal move exists.
